case_scope: United States subsystem stress case for liabilities, credit drag, health/care/disability, student debt, and criminal-legal debt

lower_half_real_floor.note: Medical debt, skipped care, and emergency-expense fragility show floor failure under ordinary shocks.

debt_fee_washout.note: Liabilities, collections, delinquency, and fines/fees wash out income and transfers.

liability_stack_drag.note: Multiple debt types interrupt floor and early foothold moments.

health_medical_debt_drag.note: Medical debt/care concerns, medical/dental borrowing, and collections exposure keep the health-debt gate failed.

student_debt_drag.note: Large portfolio and visible serious delinquency after repayment resumption; subgroup/household balance-sheet effects need direct extraction.

criminal_legal_debt_drag.note: State-created fines and fees with racialized burden and civic/mobility consequences create group veto pressure.

disability_care_interruption.note: Disability earnings penalties, extra costs, and intersectional wealth gaps make disability/care onset a threshold risk.

collections_credit_drag.note: Collections and credit-report consequences can block housing, borrowing, transport, and business formation.

group_person_closure.note: Race/disability/household composition affect debt burdens and financial security.

proof_debt: subgroup debt consequence data by race/disability/age/place/household form
direct lease/employment/license impacts of debts and collections
state/local court debt totals and revenue dependence

opening_package.second_lane: health disability care and student debt threshold protection
opening_package.rail_lane: subgroup liability data and credit/court/medical debt reporting
opening_package.hardening_lane: protected minima bankruptcy forgiveness ability-to-pay and decoupling rules
opening_package.monitoring_lane: medical collections skipped care student delinquency fines-fees and disability spend-down

reopening_triggers: skipped care because of cost rises
court debt remains linked to license record probation or jail
disability onset continues to force spend-down or housing loss

floor_reality.why: Liability stack blocks ordinary shock survival.

threshold_moments.why: Medical, student, criminal-legal, disability/care, and credit consequences block multiple threshold moments.

anti_averaging.why: Debt consequences are racialized and disability-sensitive; household averages hide person-level burden.

evidence_debt_register.question: How many people face combined medical, student, legal, collections, and disability/care liabilities at the same time?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: linked person-level liability stack dataset or convergent administrative extracts

evidence_debt_register.question: Which debts directly block leases, licenses, employment, utilities, transport, or safe exit?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: consequence-tagged debt and screening data by subgroup

validation_notes: Subsystem stress case; reinforces but does not replace the U.S. national case.
